details: Both Task1 and Task2 were executed as specified in analysis_info.json with no major deviations. The agent used the original household.dta, performed the one-sided t-test on log(totinc), ran OLS with HC0 robust SE including broad controls (Task1) and the restricted controls set (Task2), and completed the twofold Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition (Reimers equal weights) for Task1. The execution log corroborates the reported results: t-test statistics and p-value, multiple OLS variants with domlow coefficients, and Oaxaca explained/unexplained components for Task1; and the restricted OLS with domlow coefficient and robust SE for Task2. Outputs include the required domlow coefficient, SE, t-value, p-value, sample sizes, and Oaxaca components. No dataset changes or methodological substitutions were observed.
